source: 704 Fragment of Fate
target: Fragmentum Fati 704

source: The reporters waiting outside the conference hall displayed no signs of impatience or dissatisfaction, despite the passing time.
target: Diarii extra atrium conventus exspectantes nullas species impacientiae aut incontenti ostenderunt, quamquam tempus labebat.

source: They were well accustomed to such situations.
target: Itaque huic condicioni bene consueverant.

source: At last, the heavy doors of the Rose Conference Hall opened, revealing the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny.
target: Denique, graves ostia Aulae Conventus Rosae aperta sunt, ostendentes Ministerium Industria, Moran Avigny.

source: Dressed in a sharp formal suit, his dark-gray eyes and chiseled features stood out as he emerged alongside the leader of the Loen Kingdom’s delegation.
target: Indutus veste solente et formali, oculi eius obscuri-cinerei et lineamenta sculpta eminuerunt cum apparuit iuxta ducem legationis Regni Loen.

source: Snap! Snap! A flurry of loud camera flashes illuminated the scene, and Moran Avigny responded with a graceful wave to the reporters.
target: Snap! Snap! Turbidus fulgorium clamoribus camerae scenam illustravit, et Moran Avigny diariis gratiosa fluctuatione respondit.

source: Lumian refrained from pushing his way to the front, choosing instead to observe Moran Avigny from a distance, hidden among the crowd.
target: Lumian impetum ad limitem non adiit, sed potius a longe, inter turbam absconditus, Moran Avigny intueri maluit.

source: Shielded by the camera, his azure eyes rapidly shifted to a silver-black hue.
target: Armatus a camera, oculi eius caerulei celeriter mutaverunt colorem in nigrum-argenteum.

source: Eye of Calamity!
target: Oculus Calamitatum!

source: In Lumian’s enhanced vision, a river of mercury materialized on Moran Avigny’s body, composed of ethereal water droplets.
target: In visu Luminiani amplificata flumen mercurii in corpore Moran Avigny apparuit, ex guttulis aquae aetheriae constantibus.

source: Each droplet was adorned with intricate, interconnected symbols.
target: Quisque gutta insignibus intricatis et conexis ornata erat.

source: As Moran Avigny delivered a concise speech announcing various industrial cooperation agreements between the Intis Republic and the Loen Kingdom, Lumian meticulously analyzed the Minister of Industry’s past, present, and future, uncovering the fragments of fate concealed within each mercurial droplet.
target: Dum Moran Avigny brevem orationem habili sermonis de variis foedus industrialis cooperationis inter Rempublicam Intis et Regnum Loen enuntiavit, Lumian praeteritum, praesens atque futurum Ministerii Industria diligenter perscrutatus est, fragmenta fati in qualibet gutta mercuriali latenta detegens.

source: The more distant the past, the greater the ambiguity.
target: Quo longius praeteritum, eo maiorem incertitudinem.

source: Lumian concentrated on the events of the preceding two weeks.
target: Lumian eventus duarum septimanarum superiorum summo studio consideravit.

source: He witnessed Moran Avigny residing in a government-provided villa, attending weekly gatherings at cafés to discuss matters of state, exemplifying Trier’s café politics.
target: Testis fuit Moran Avigny in villa a gubernatione provisa habitare, conventus hebdomadae in cauponis ad res publicas disserendas frequentare, exemplar praebens politiae cauponarum Trevirensium.

source: Furthermore, Lumian observed Moran Avigny’s attendance at salons, balls, banquets, operas, concerts, theaters, and art exhibitions.
target: Praeterea, Lumian animadvertit Moran Avigny adesse in salones, ballets, cenis, operis, concentibus, theatris atque exhibitionibus artium.

source: The Minister indulged in polo, poker, hunting in the suburbs, and flirtations with courtesans.
target: Minister se dedidit ludo polo, ludo poker, venatione in periurbibus, et amatoria cum cortesanis.

source: He leveraged his position to secure favors, such as appointing the husband of one of his lovers as the deputy general manager of the Intis Industrial Credit Bank’s Southern Continent branch—a coveted role known for its prestige, generous compensation, and influence.
target: Officio suo utebatur ut favores obtineret, ut exempli gratia, maritum unae amatarum suae designans ut vicarius generalis procuratoris ramus Meridianae Continenti Intis Industrial Credit Bank, munere exoptato ob gloriam, largam compensationem, atque auctoritatem notum.

source: The sole drawback was the necessity of leaving Trier for the Southern Continent for two to three years, initially without the companionship of spouse and children.
target: Unicum incommodum erat necessitatem Trier relinquendi ad Continentem Meridionalem per duo vel tres annos, initio sine coniugis atque liberorum comitate.

source: These observations aligned perfectly with Lumian’s preconceived notions of Trier’s elite society.
target: Observationes hae perfecte conveniebant cum praeconceptis Luminiani de societate electa Trevirensium.

source: Amidst the hazy fragments, two particular instances captured Lumian’s attention.
target: Inter fragmenta nebulosa duo casus peculiares attentionem Luminiani cepere.

source: In one, Moran Avigny sat alone in his study, perusing a document.
target: In uno, Moran Avigny solus in studiis sedebat, documentum perlegens.

source: Abruptly, he jotted down a note and reached into a nearby mirror.
target: Subito, notam annotavit et ad speculum prope appropinquans tendit.

source: His hand, seemingly incorporeal, passed through the glass surface, depositing the note within.
target: Manus eius, quasi incorporea, per superficiem vitri transiit, notam intus deponens.

source: The other featured Moran Avigny’s fleeting encounter with an unfamiliar individual during a hunting excursion in the West Lognes Forest.
target: Alter casus brevissimum congressum Moran Avigny cum individuo ignoto in expeditione venatoria in Silva Lognes Occidentali exhibuit.

source: What piqued Lumian’s interest was the thin, white fog enveloping this fragment, rendering it indistinct.
target: Quod studio Luminiani excitavit, tenuis alba nebula huius fragmenti involvens, ut fere indistinctum esset.

source: This peculiar obscurity differed from the typical vagueness of most fate fragments.
target: Haec obscuritas insolita differebat ab vagitate typica plurimorum fragmentorum fati.

source: The first fragment confirmed Moran Avigny’s identity as a Mirror Person.
target: Primum fragmentum identitatem Moran Avigny ut Personam Speculi confirmavit.

source: Among the 22 paths of the divine, Demonesses proficient in mirror magic could not transmit information or objects through mirrors until attaining the rank of Sequence 4 demigods.
target: Inter viginti duos semitas divinitatis, daemoniae in arte magica speculi peritae informationes aut res per specula transmittere non poterant, nisi ad gradum Sequenciae IV semideorum pervenerunt.

source: If Moran Avigny were a demigod-level Demoness, his existence as a man would be impossible.
target: Si Moran Avigny daemonia semidei gradu fuisset, exsistentia eius ut vir impossibilis fuisset.

source: Lumian could only surmise two possibilities:
target: Lumian solum duas possibilitates coniectare potuit:

source: First, Mirror People possessed an innate mastery over mirrors, surpassing even Demonesses in the realm of mirror magic.
target: Primum, Personae Speculi ingenio innato speculos dominabantur, etiam daemonias in regno magiae speculi superantes.

source: Second, Moran Avigny had originally been a Demoness at the demigod level who later consumed a higher Sequence Hunter potion, successfully transforming into a man.
target: Secundo, Moran Avigny initio daemonia semidei gradus fuit, quae postea potionem Venatoris Sequenciae superioris consumpsit, ut vir feliciter convertus esset.

source: This implied that the Minister of Industry was at least a Sequence 3 Saint, if not an Angel.
target: Hoc implicabat Ministerium Industria saltem Sanctum Sequenciae III, nisi Angelum, esse.

source: Considering the intelligence gathered by Franca and the others, the information provided by 007, and the clearer fate fragments, Lumian concluded that Moran Avigny had never exhibited any Hunter-related traits.
target: Intelligentiā a Franca aliisque collecta, informatione a 007 data, et fragmentis fati clarioribus, Lumian concludit Moran Avigny numquam ullas notas Venatoris ostentasse.

source: He was undoubtedly a Mirror Person, albeit an extraordinary one.
target: Indubitanter Personam Speculi fuisse constat, quamquam extraordinariam.

source: The second fate fragment intrigued Lumian due to its relative uniqueness.
target: Secundum fragmentum fati Luminiani, ob singularem naturam, animum excitavit.

source: It might contain crucial information, but deciphering it eluded him for the moment.
target: Forsitan informationes maximas contineat, sed eius enodatio momento ei eluderet.

source: Shifting his focus to Moran Avigny’s future, Lumian examined the myriad potential fate tributaries.
target: Ad futurum Moran Avigny se convertere, Lumian multitudinem fluminum fati potentialium inspiciebat.

source: As anticipated, one tributary bore a faint black tinge.
target: Ut praevisum erat, unus flumen fati levem nigram notam portabat.

source: This mercurial offshoot, like many others, “rehearsed” Moran Avigny’s interview and subsequent return to the Ministry of Industry in a private carriage.
target: Haec derivatio mercurialis, ut pleraeque aliae, “repraesentavit” colloquium Moran Avigny et reditum postea ad Ministerium Industria in curru privato.

source: However, it diverged when, upon entering his office and sitting for a while, Moran Avigny willingly stepped into the full-body mirror near the coat rack and vanished.
target: Attamen, divertebat, cum in officium suum ingressus et per aliquod tempus sedens, Moran Avigny libenter in speculum totum prope armarium vestimentorum intravit et evanuit.

source: Lumian’s foresight extended no further.
target: Praevisio Luminiani ultra non extendebatur.

source: Based on his observations, Lumian deduced that if Moran Avigny ventured into the mirror world before noon, he would face a life-threatening calamity.
target: Ex observationibus suis Lumian concludere audivit: si Moran Avigny ante meridiem in mundum speculi se immergisset, discrimen vitae immineret.

source: Yet, the probability of Moran Avigny taking such an action was minimal.
target: Attamen, verisimilitudo ut Moran Avigny talem rem ageret, exiguum erat.

source: Among the numerous fate tributaries, only one represented this possibility.
target: Inter multas flumina fati, sola una hanc facultatem repraesentabat.

source: Certainly, if Lumian disregarded the risk of exposure, he could harness nearly half of his spirituality to manipulate Moran Avigny’s future, steering it towards that specific tributary.
target: Certe, si Lumian periculum manifestationis neglexisset, fere dimidiam spiritualitatis suae vim ad futurum Moran Avigny formandum et in illum flumen specificum dirigens adhibere posset.

source: However, such an act would be futile.
target: Attamen, talis actus vanus esset.

source: Moran Avigny’s demise in the mirror world would merely prevent them from accessing his corpse and conducting the spirit channeling ritual.
target: Interitus Moran Avigny in mundo speculi solum eos prohiberet ut corpus eius attingeretur atque rituum spirituum canalizationem peragirent.

source: The Demoness of Black likely possesses the ability to enter the mirror world as well.
target: Daemonia Nigra probabiliter etiam facultatem habet ut in mundum speculi ingrediatur.

source: However, with her as the spirit channeler, obtaining the relevant information would prove impossible.
target: Attamen, cum ea spirituum canalizatrix esset, necessaria informationes colligere impossibilis fuisset.

source: Even if Franca has fully earned her trust, certain knowledge would remain undisclosed until she attains a specific Sequence…
target: Etiam si Franca plenam eius fiduciam adeptus fuerit, quaedam scientia non revelabatur, donec ad certam Sequenciam perveniret…

source: Lumian noticed Moran Avigny’s posture signaling the conclusion of the interview, and his bodyguards began navigating through the reporters.
target: Lumian animadvertit morum statum Moran Avigny, qui finis colloquii significabat, et custodes eius inter diarii perambulare coeperunt.

source: Consequently, Lumian ceased using the Eye of Calamity and captured a black-and-white photograph, maintaining his façade.
target: Consecuto, Lumian usum Oculi Calamitatum desiit et photographiam nigro-albam ceperat, simulacrum suum servans.

source: Subsequently, he gradually retreated from the throng of reporters and made his way to the public washroom.
target: Postea paulatim a turbam diariorum recedens via publicam latrinam intravit.

source: He stashed the camera within his Traveler’s Bag, donned Lie, and transformed back into Ciel Dubois.
target: Cameram in sacco Viatoris suo recondidit, veste “Lie” indutus est, et ad statum Ciel Dubois revertit.

source: As a guest, he entered the annex restaurant of Champs-Élysées.
target: Hospite, restaurant annexum in Champs-Élysées ingressus est.

source: Franca awaited him there.
target: Franca ibi eum exspectabat.

source: Following the waiter to his designated spot, Lumian noticed a man and a woman engaged in coffee.
target: Ministrum sequens ad locum designatum, Lumian virum ac feminam in colloquio cafei versantes animadvertit.

source: The woman possessed black hair, brown eyes, and an alluring beauty.
target: Femina capillos nigros, oculos fuscos, atque venustatem allicientem habebat.

source: Her attire accentuated her slightly exaggerated aura.
target: Vestis eius modum paululum exaggeratum aurae ejus exprimebat.

source: The man, by contrast, appeared ordinary, clad in a double-breasted flannel coat, wrinkled pants, buckled leather boots, and a top hat adorned with soft fur—the favored ensemble of Trier’s bankers and financiers in recent times.
target: Vir autem, contra, simplex videbatur, indutus in lorica flannel duplici pectori, braccis rugosis, calceamentis coriaceis fibulis allatis, et pileo ornato molli peli—habitus praestantissimus bankerorum et nummularum Trevirensium nuper.

source: Lumian noticed that the man and woman weren’t attracted by any aura of wealth.
target: Lumian animadvertit virum ac feminam non allici a quacumque aura divitiarum.

source: Instead, he recognized the beautiful woman with foreign features.
target: Immo, agnovit pulchram feminam cum externis lineamentis.

source: She, of course, had no knowledge of him.
target: Ipsa, scilicet, de eo nihil noverat.

source: He had only glimpsed her photograph in Ghost Face.
target: Eum solum imaginem eius in “Ghost Face” intuens aspiciebat.

source: She was Perle, a theater actress from Loen and a courtesan in Trier.
target: Ea Perle erat, actrix theatralis ex Loen et cortisana Trevirensis.

source: DuVar, the inventor of DuVar’s broth and proprietor of the esteemed restaurant, had once lavished a substantial sum on her.
target: DuVar, inventor brodi DuVar et possessor clarissimi restaurantis, olim magnam pecuniae summam super eam effudit.

source: He had even attempted suicide because of her, albeit unsuccessfully.
target: Etiam propter eam ad se ipsos perditionem conatus est, quamquam non prospere.

source: At present, Perle and the middle-aged man, presumed to be a banker, had not yet begun their meal.
target: Nunc, Perle et vir mediocris aetatis, qui banker esse credebatur, adhuc cibum suum non inceperant.

source: They were simply savoring their coffee.
target: Solebant simpliciter saporem cafei degustare.

source: The middle-aged man picked up Perle’s empty coffee cup and gestured to the grounds, explaining something unknown to Lumian.
target: Vir mediocris aetatis poculum cafeae vacuum Perle arripuit et ad residua monstrare gesticulatus est, aliquid Luminiano ignotum explanans.

source: The courtesan listened intently.
target: Cortisana attente audivit.

source: As he passed by, Lumian’s keen senses allowed him to briefly eavesdrop.
target: Dum praeteribat, sensus acuti Luminiani breviter auscultare sinere.

source: He swiftly grasped that the middle-aged man, believed to be a banker, was immersed in the art of coffee ground divination.
target: Celeriter intellexit virum mediocris aetatis, banker existimatum, in arte divinationis residuorum cafeae versari.

source: This popular divination method in high society was more akin to a game.
target: Haec methodus divinatoria in societate alta popularis maxime quasi ludus erat.

source: “If the remaining coffee grounds after drinking form a circle, it signifies recent signs of love…”
target: «Si residuae particulae cafeae post potum circulum efficiunt, signa recentis amoris indicant…»

source: Upon hearing the middle-aged man’s words, Lumian couldn’t help but silently critique: Are you going to suggest that you’ll be the love she’s about to encounter?
target: Auditis verbis viri mediocris aetatis, Lumian tacite censere non potuit: Num proponere intendis te futurum amorem, quem ipsa mox experietur?

source: Any other woman, even aware of the man’s true intentions, would be secretly alarmed by divination results indicating traces of love.
target: Quaevis alia femina, etiamsi de veris propositis viri conscius esset, arcano perterrita fuisset ex resultatibus divinatoriis quae vestigia amoris ostenderent.

source: They might believe it to be fate’s guidance.
target: Fortasse putarent hoc esse ducatum fati.

source: The various patterns naturally formed by the residual coffee grounds were thought to hold corresponding revelations about one’s destiny, a notion widely accepted and impossible to manipulate.
target: Figurae varias a residuīs cafeae naturaliter formatae, opinabantur revelationes congruentes de fato contineant, sententia late recepta et nequissima ad manipulationem.

source: However, given Perle’s experience as a seasoned courtesan and her bold demeanor, Lumian had cause to suspect that she had deliberately manipulated the coffee grounds into a circular formation through her drinking technique.
target: Attamen, ratione Perle peritiae ut cortisana callida et habitu audaci, Lumian suspicari coepit eam residua cafeae per artem suae potionis consuetudinis ad formam circularem deliberatam composuisse.

source: After walking a short distance, Lumian spotted Franca.
target: Postquam spatium breve ambulavit, Lumian Francam animadvertit.

source: The Demoness of Pleasure was dressed as a lady today, perfectly suited for the occasion.
target: Daemonia Voluptatis hodie ut domina ornata erat, ad occasionem perfecte conveniens.

source: Lumian almost failed to recognize her.
target: Lumian paene eam agnoscere non potuit.

source: Naturally, Franca still refrained from wearing a dress, opting instead for a pantsuit.
target: Naturale, Franca adhuc a vestimentis longis abstinebat, potius vestem braccatim eligens.

source: Observing Franca’s elegantly styled hair, no longer in a ponytail, Lumian chuckled and remarked, “Jenna did your hair for you?”
target: Observans elegantissime dispositos capillos Francae, nondum in cauda colligatos, Lumian subsannavit atque dixit: “Jenna tibi capillos compaginavit?”

source: “Indeed!” Franca responded, not with humiliated rage, but with a sense of smugness.
target: “Revera!” respondit Franca, non cum ira confusa sed cum modica superbia.

source: Before they could delve into their observations, a nearby waiter approached, presenting them with two identical menus.
target: Priusquam observationibus penitus inciperent, ministrus proximus accessit, duos menus eandem speciem offerens.

source: Lowering her voice, Franca addressed Lumian in ancient Feysac, “The lunch set costs 7 verl d’or. If we order individually and indulge in some decent red wine, the bill for the two of us will amount to at least 50 verl d’or. That sum could easily feed your godson in the market district.”
target: Vox demitte, Franca Luminiano in antiqua Feysac loquebatur: “Set prandiarii constat ex 7 verl d’or. Si singillatim ordinaverimus et bonum vinum rubrum degustaverimus, computus nostrum saltem 50 verl d’or attinget. Illa summa facile nepotem tuum in regione mercatus pascere posset.”

source: Franca found the restaurant at Grand Champs-Élysées not only expensive but also intriguing.
target: Franca invenit restaurant in Grand Champs-Élysées non solum pretiosum sed etiam mirabile.

source: Switching to Intisian, Franca inquired of the waiter, “Any recommendations?”
target: Transiens ad linguam Intisian, Franca ministrum interrogavit: “Quid suades?”

source: The waiter, who had been sneaking glances at Franca, responded eagerly, “Would you like to try the Fürth fish?
target: Ministrus, qui Francam furtim intuens erat, studiose respondit: “Velisne piscem Fürth experiri?

source: “In Trier, apart from certain private banquets, we are the sole establishment that serves Fürth fish.”
target: “In Treviris, praeter nonnulla privata convivia, sola instituta sumus quae piscem Fürth praebet.”

source: “What makes it so special?” Lumian asked, curiosity piqued.
target: “Quid id tam speciale facit?” inquit Lumian, curiositate excitato.

source: Addressing Franca, the waiter explained, “Fürth fish appear semi-charred and can only be found in a specific section of Trier’s underground river. Legend has it that long ago, they were ordinary fish. One day, an individual named Fürth caught one and set up a frying pan by the underground river, intending to cook it. Midway through the process, the fish managed to escape the frying pan and return to the river. It survived and spawned numerous descendants, all bearing the semi-charred appearance.
target: Ad Francam loquens, ministrus explicavit: “Piscēs Fürth videntur semi-combusti et solummodo in certa parte fluminis subterranei Trevirensium inveniri possunt. Mito narratur olim fuisse pisces comunes. Quadam die, quispiam nomine Fürth unum cepit et sartaginem iuxta flumen subterraneum posuit cum proposito ei coquendum. Medio processu piscis ex sartagine effugere et in flumen redire potuit; supervixit atque multos posteros genuit, omnes aspectu semi-combusto induti.

source: “The skin of this fish is fragrantly browned and oily, yet the flesh within is exceptionally tender…”
target: “Cutis huius piscis fragrante fusca et oleosa est, sed caro intima eximie tenera…”

source: Trier’s underground river… Half-burnt… Alive… Lumian extracted the keywords and suddenly speculated that this might be a consequence of the leakage of Fourth Epoch Trier’s Hunter powers.
target: Flumen subterraneum Trevirense… Semicombustum… Vivum… Luminian verba clavis extraxit et subito coniectavit hoc forsitan consequentiam effusionis potestatum Venatorum Temporis Quarti Trevirensis esse.

source: Smiling at Franca, he proposed, “Shall we each have one?”
target: Subridens Francae, proposuit: “Num uterque nostrum unum habeamus?”

source: “Very well.” Franca had already been contemplating giving it a try.
target: “Optime.” Franca iam id experiri cogitaverat.
